authority: Main Opus is the sole release integrator. BRANCH_OWNERSHIP.md is the human-readable boundary; this file is the machine-readable claim and review record. Edit only your own entries; the integrator owns 'reviews' and 'integration'.

protocol.claim: Before starting a cluster, append {id, operator, branch, files, claimed_at} to 'claims' via a commit on YOUR branch AND a comment on your PR. The integrator copies accepted claims here.
protocol.handoff: Push your branch, open or update a PR into claude/w4-INTEG8-next (never merge it), and put a handoff doc at brambleloop/research/final_build/w4/<OPERATOR>_HANDOFF.md naming exact SHAs, files and tests.
protocol.review: The integrator records verdicts below and as a PR comment: ACCEPT, CHANGES_REQUIRED, BLOCKED or REJECTED, with SHA, files and tests.
protocol.wake: The integrator is woken by GitHub PR activity on subscribed PRs, and by a bounded recurring check-in. Neither is a guarantee of immediate response; usage limits apply.

owner_directives.summary: Etsy AI-generated-craft-pattern policy is a channel-specific publication gate only; never a company-wide engineering blocker. All internal stages continue. Investigate genuinely human-developed patterns and alternative channels. Never fabricate authorship, testing or provenance; never publish against confirmed platform restrictions or bypass safeguards.

Permanent: return to the original Master Plan / Build 2 / Final Master / P0 workforce roadmap. No further Etsy AI-pattern policy research or compliance engineering; preserve existing safeguards; handle a publication-eligibility requirement only when that specific publication action needs it. Never misrepresent authorship, testing or provenance. The issue must not block any engineering, product development, certification, PDFs, imagery, listing packages or other channels. Goal: 24/7 Railway operation independent of Claude sessions. Coordinate via GitHub; Secondary Opus continues unowned P0; Main Opus integrates, certifies, deploys.

Owner authorizes PLANNING around a maximum CA$66 tester budget for the small Hexagonal Bread Basket; NOT authorization to commission or pay. Before final commissioning approval: independent review of the Rnd 10->11 base-to-wall transition (no invented technique), internal consistency of dimensions/gauge/yarn, fix any real defect at source and recertify, preserve full-make testing/shape checks/measurements/unedited photos, confirm tester independence and qualification and that CA$66 covers fee and materials. Premium PDF improvements stay on the roadmap (7-page tester PDF not yet at commercial standard).

APPROVED: back-loop-only transition at Rnd 11 of the small Hexagonal Bread Basket, the smallest source change, for a defined base-to-wall edge. Preserve six-sided geometry and counts; recalculate gauge/dimensions/yarn; regenerate US/UK PDFs, tester kit, diagrams and visual specs; revalidate and recertify; independent review of the design change; every listing asset references the exact certified version. No tester against 1.2.1. CA$66 ceiling provisional until the final kit is approved.

Present tranche 1 (five items) with designer, title, CAD price, link, knowledge gained, relevance, duplicate check and licence; verify the two MJ's basket benchmark IDs against the owner's original links. No purchases without explicit approval.

Track separately: implemented, independently reviewed, integrated, certified, deployed, production verified, end-to-end operational. Final acceptance needs a meaningful 24-hour production run showing automatic product progression, learning, recovery and next-product selection. No publication with unresolved High-severity visual or technical defects.

integrator_decisions.summary: After seven review rounds each found a new restatement that moves the design digest (version, notation, hold names, hold order, seams, quantity, gauge) and every one failed OPEN by scoping or lifting a size halt, the digest is no longer used to scope or lift any size halt. Every size halt is product-wide; it lifts only by an owner action (session + step-up, audited) with evidence of a passing full make of a recertified release by an independent tester whose measured size agrees. The digest is kept for evidence only. Digest-scoped halts may return only with a canonical design identity that passes adversarial review. Trades F-168 scoping for fail-closed safety; no real samples exist yet.
